Vitamin A Deficiency.recommendation_text: Student shows signs of Vitamin A deficiency. Refer for clinical confirmation and dietary counseling.
Vitamin A Deficiency.recommended_foods: Camote tops, squash, malunggay, carrots, egg yolk, liver

Vitamin D Deficiency.recommendation_text: Low Vitamin D levels suspected. Encourage 15-20 minutes of morning sun exposure daily and dietary changes.
Vitamin D Deficiency.recommended_foods: Milk, canned sardines, egg yolk, fortified cereals

Vitamin C Deficiency.recommendation_text: Signs consistent with Vitamin C deficiency (bleeding gums, fatigue). Increase citrus fruit intake.
Vitamin C Deficiency.recommended_foods: Guava, calamansi, orange, tomato, green leafy vegetables

Vitamin B12 Deficiency.recommendation_text: Possible Vitamin B12 deficiency. Recommend increase in animal protein intake and clinical referral.
Vitamin B12 Deficiency.recommended_foods: Beef, chicken liver, eggs, dairy products, fish

Iron Deficiency.recommendation_text: Iron deficiency anemia suspected. Prioritise iron-rich foods and Vitamin C to aid absorption.
Iron Deficiency.recommended_foods: Malunggay, kangkong, beef liver, mongo, camote tops, sardines

Folate Deficiency.recommendation_text: Folate deficiency indicated. Increase dark green vegetable consumption.
Folate Deficiency.recommended_foods: Malunggay, spinach, asparagus, mongo beans, fortified bread

Iodine Deficiency.recommendation_text: Possible iodine deficiency. Ensure use of iodized salt and seafood intake.

Severe Malnutrition.recommendation_text: Severe malnutrition risk detected. Immediate referral to health center required. Enroll in school feeding program.
Severe Malnutrition.recommended_foods: High-calorie therapeutic foods, fortified porridge, RUTF if available

Normal.recommendation_text: No nutritional deficiency detected. Maintain a balanced diet and healthy lifestyle.
Normal.recommended_foods: Balanced diet: vegetables, fruits, protein, grains, dairy
